reason: Chalice CLI quickstart can create a project and serve it locally with `chalice local` on CPU without AWS credentials.
demo: README Quickstart: chalice new-project, then run the app locally with chalice local
goal: Install chalice from the repo clone and make the quickstart work offline: `chalice new-project helloworld` then `chalice local --port 8000` inside that project (no AWS deploy, no credentials). Write /work/run.sh so it creates the project at /work/helloworld (if missing), starts `chalice local --port 8000` in the background (nohup), and waits until http://127.0.0.1:8000/ responds. Write /work/env.sh to activate the environment where chalice is installed.
check: The local server on port 8000 returns {"hello": "world"} for GET /, and a freshly scaffolded project with a couple of extra routes is served with chalice local and answers them correctly.

revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: The oracle scaffolds its own project with `chalice new-project` but never serves it. The only HTTP check hits the project that run.sh created, so the oracle never runs the demo on an input it controls.
Only the template's single GET / route is exercised. Path parameters and request bodies, the routing that the generated app.py itself documents, are never tested.

v2 appends the two example routes from the generated app.py's comments to the oracle's project and serves it with `chalice local --port 8765 --no-autoreload`. It checks GET /, GET /hello/{name}, a POST JSON echo and that an unknown route does not return 200, and keeps the run.sh GET / check. Check sentence updated.
evidence: oracles/aws-chalice.sh:5-11 — demoapp is created and grepped, but curl only targets port 8000 (run.sh's /work/helloworld)

src/aws-chalice@ed8eca1d chalice/cli/__init__.py:410-427 — new-project default type is 'legacy'; chalice/templates/0009-legacy/app.py:6-27 — GET / {'hello':'world'} plus the commented /hello/{name} and POST /users json_body examples
src/aws-chalice chalice/cli/__init__.py:104-113 — chalice local --host/--port/--autoreload options; chalice/local.py:524 — unknown routes return 403 'Missing Authentication Token'
